_description: Layout library of the layout analysis, by KeyboardEvent.code. An entry with « keys » is an alphabetic block (3 rows, base characters only), imported on 2026-11-14 from the Oxeylyzer layout set (Apache-2.0 repository) and, for the classics it lacks, from the cmini collection (GPL-3.0 repository); the codegen completes it with the US number row and the US Shift pairs (letters: upper case). An entry with « rows » is a whole layout (base, Shift, AltGr, Shift+AltGr of every key its file states), imported on 2026-11-17 from Keyboard Layout Analyzer's built-in layouts (MIT repository) by tools/build/import-kla-layouts.cjs; the codegen takes it as it is. Only the arrangements are re-encoded, never a file, on the basis given in docs/audits/layout-analysers/report.md, section « Layout library ». « source » and « source_path » name the file each layout comes from; « not_imported » lists the files of these collections left out, with the reason and, for a duplicate, the library layout with the same keys (« same_as »). The registry layouts (static/layouts/registry) and the reference QWERTY and AZERTY (layout_composer/reference_layouts.js) join the library at codegen with all their layers and dead keys, so they are not repeated here.
